description: This file is the entry point for a React application utilizing ReactDOM to render the main App component into the root DOM element. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the App component, and initiates the rendering process.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React application into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the specified DOM node.
